scientific_integrity: Universal assertions are supported by analytic period-map calculations. Finite checks confirm but cannot replace the proof. No claim of independent validation.
scientific_limitations: Exact, constant-step, two-dimensional balanced sign switching; small-stepsize sufficiency is for each fixed dwell length. One related 2026 full manuscript was inaccessible, so bibliographic overlap remains a risk.
title: Five-step dwell is the sharp small-stepsize stabilization threshold for sign-switched reflected gradient
